{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Duplicate patient_id counts:")
duplicate_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = duplicate_counts[duplicate_counts > 1]
print(duplicates.head())

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print("\nNumber of -999 values in biomarker_baseline:")
print((df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for assay_batch and biomarker_final
print("\nUnique assay_batch values:")
print(df['assay_batch'].unique())

print("\nRaw mean biomarker_final (before correction):")
print(df['biomarker_final'].mean())"}
